source.implementation: independent FP32 vector reference, full native16 key/48 value heads, two tokens

hypothesis: Unroll each persistent DSR FMA walk by8. Keep every K term in the identical ascending order with unchanged FP32 FMA, normalization/exp and complete state/history. Reduce loop branch/index overhead while preserving pointer progress and bank offset.
falsification: Reject any changed normalization/exp/FMA ordering, skipped K/V term/group/token/history, descriptor overrun or bank side effect, fixed numerical/state/precision/timing failure, shutdown failure, speedup below1.05x or memory above1.10x. Full six-case matched and fresh pairs required; PR1 GQA gains do not establish recurrent gains.
